query: Conference Board CCI expectations next release

results.content: The Conference Board's Expectations Index tracks consumers' six-month outlook for income, business conditions, and the labor market. Readings below 80 have historically been associated with an elevated risk of recession within the next twelve months — it is the level the Conference Board itself has described as the point below which economic expansion is not being signaled. The Expectations Index has been below 80 continuously since February 2025, a streak of eighteen months through July 2026, [...] But that stability is not the full story.
